podcast.body: This album features eight songs recorded in eight different cities across eight different studios, a process also documented in an HBO TV series. The band would absorb local vibes and talk with musicians in each city, with Dave Grohl then crafting lyrics from transcriptions of these conversations. The album was designed to lay bare the influences on its songs and the band members themselves. "Sonic Highways. Eight songs recorded in eight different cities in eight different studios."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album features the single "Something from Nothing," which contains a passage at about 90 seconds into the song that some consider a subtle tribute to Ronnie James Dio's "Holy Diver." "One of the big singles off the Foo Fighters' Sonic Highway's album was Something From Nothing."
